mechanism: Eslicarbazepine induces CYP3A4, reducing verapamil metabolism and increasing its plasma concentration, while verapamil may inhibit eslicarbazepine metabolism through CYP450 pathways, creating bidirectional interaction potential.
action: Monitor heart rate, blood pressure, and ECG; consider verapamil dose reduction; monitor for eslicarbazepine efficacy changes and increased adverse effects.
